name: stacked-activity
title: Stacked Activity Bars
description: Interactive stacked daily columns with a live legend that doubles as the tooltip; the last, incomplete day is hatched.

meta.question: What makes up each day's volume, and how does it breathe day to day?
meta.whenToUse: Daily volume split into 2-4 additive parts over weeks of data, where per-day composition matters as much as the trend.
meta.antiUse: Comparing exact values of individual segments across days (inner segments have no common baseline) or fewer than 5 days.
